title: feat: compare daily revenue week over week
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a standalone daily revenue pulse chart outside the KPI catalogue and table
- Compares this week with the same weekdays last week
- Uses paid Stripe checkout revenue from the existing Tinybird source
- Marks the current day as partial and adds focused comparison coverage

gist.headline: Revenue Gets a Memory
gist.blurb: The KPI hive now gives today’s Stripe pollen a proper side-by-side with the same weekdays last week. Even the partial day gets a little flag instead of pretending it has finished photosynthesizing.
gist.summary: Added a standalone daily revenue pulse chart to the operations KPI dashboard, comparing paid Stripe checkout revenue for this week against the matching weekdays last week and marking the current day as partial.
gist.impact: Operators can now spot week-over-week checkout-revenue movement at a glance without digging through the KPI catalogue or table, with incomplete current-day totals clearly identified.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy operations garden dashboard: Polli, wearing tiny analyst glasses, compares two growing lines of honey jars or flower stems labeled this week and last week on a CRT chart. The current-day jar is still filling, represented by a small partial-day marker, while code-plants and lime-green dashboard glow connect the scene to internal analytics.
